# store

Types from PocketBase's Go package `store`, as JavaScript sees them: you get these objects from [`$app` and the other globals](/docs/reference/javascript/pocketbase) and from hook events, and call their methods by their JS names (Go's `FindRecordById` is `findRecordById`). The same package in Go: [store](/docs/reference/go/pocketbase/tools/store).

## store.Store

Store defines a concurrent safe in memory key-value data store.

| Member | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `reset()` | <code>(newData: { [key: string]: any }): void</code> | Reset clears the store and replaces the store data with a shallow copy of the provided newData. |
| `length()` | <code>(): number</code> | Length returns the current number of elements in the store. |
| `removeAll()` | <code>(): void</code> | RemoveAll removes all the existing store entries. |
| `remove()` | <code>(key: K): void</code> | Remove removes a single entry from the store. |
| `has()` | <code>(key: K): boolean</code> | Has checks if element with the specified key exist or not. |
| `get()` | <code>(key: K): T</code> | Get returns a single element value from the store. |
| `getOk()` | <code>(key: K): [T, boolean]</code> | GetOk is similar to Get but returns also a boolean indicating whether the key exists or not. |
| `getAll()` | <code>(): { [key: string]: any }</code> | GetAll returns a shallow copy of the current store data. |
| `keys()` | <code>(): Array&lt;K&gt;</code> | Keys returns a slice with all of the store keys. |
| `values()` | <code>(): Array&lt;T&gt;</code> | Values returns a slice with all of the store values. |
| `set()` | <code>(key: K, value: T): void</code> | Set sets (or overwrite if already exists) a new value for key. |
| `setFunc()` | <code>(key: K, fn: (old: T) =&gt; T): void</code> | SetFunc sets (or overwrite if already exists) a new value resolved from the function callback for the provided key. |
| `getOrSet()` | <code>(key: K, setFunc: () =&gt; T): T</code> | GetOrSet retrieves a single existing value for the provided key or stores a new one if it doesn't exist. |
| `setIfLessThanLimit()` | <code>(key: K, value: T, maxAllowedElements: number): boolean</code> | SetIfLessThanLimit sets (or overwrite if already exist) a new value for key. |
| `unmarshalJSON()` | <code>(data: string&#124;Array&lt;number&gt;): void</code> | UnmarshalJSON implements `json.unmarshaler` and imports the provided JSON data into the store. |
| `marshalJSON()` | <code>(): string&#124;Array&lt;number&gt;</code> | MarshalJSON implements `json.marshaler` and export the current store data into valid JSON. |
